name: audio.speech-ratio
title: Speech-to-background ratio
summary: How far a voice sits above its background inside the speech band (default 300-3400 Hz), per line or per given window, with the minimum and median ratio.
description: Both signals are downmixed to mono at 48 kHz and band-limited with one RBJ high-pass and one RBJ low-pass. 100 ms frames whose band-limited voice power is below -45 dBFS are dropped, then voice, background and their ratio are averaged over the same frames. Analysis only; it changes nothing.

voice.description: Voice (dialogue) file: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

background.description: Background (music, ambience) file, on the same timeline as the voice.

timeline.description: Optional timeline JSON (timeline.layout output) used to resolve string times in windows.

windows.description: Explicit windows. Omit to find lines automatically from voice activity.

name.description: Optional label copied into the result row.

from.description: Window start: seconds or a timespec (scene id, cue, bar:n, beat:n).

to.description: Window end: seconds or a timespec (scene id, cue, bar:n, beat:n).

band_hz.description: Speech band as [high-pass, low-pass] corner frequencies in Hz.

activity_threshold_db.description: Automatic windows: a 100 ms unfiltered-voice frame is active when its RMS is above this dBFS level.

min_gap_s.description: Automatic windows: merge active runs separated by a gap shorter than this many seconds.

rows.description: One row per window, in order.

name.description: Window label (line-1, line-2, ... for automatic windows).

voice_db.description: Mean band-limited voice power in dBFS, or null when no frame was kept.

background_db.description: Mean band-limited background power over the same frames in dBFS, or null when no frame was kept.

ratio_db.description: voice_db - background_db, or null when no frame was kept.

summary.description: Minimum and median ratio over the non-null rows, or null when there are none.
